import csv, collections
# Load catalog to map zone->(temp_sensor_tsid, cool_setpoint_tsid, heat_setpoint_tsid)
cat=list(csv.DictReader(open(CATALOG_CSV)))
z2p=collections.defaultdict(dict)
for r in cat:
    uri=r['point_uri']
    seg=uri.rsplit('#',1)[-1]
    zname,pname=seg.split('.',1)
    z2p[zname][pname]=r['timeseries_id']

ts_ids=set(r['timeseries_id'] for r in cat)
# Load values
val=list(csv.DictReader(open(VALUES_CSV)))
data=collections.defaultdict(lambda: collections.defaultdict(float))
for r in val:
    if r['timeseries_id'] in ts_ids:
        data[r['timeseries_id']][r['timestamp']]=float(r['value'])

# time range
allts=set()
for r in val: allts.add(r['timestamp'])
allts=sorted(allts)
print("N ts:", len(val), "range:", allts[0], "to", allts[-1])

# For each zone compute avg temperature before July 2018 vs after
import statistics
zones=sensor_zones=[z for z in z2p if 'Zone_Air_Temperature_Sensor' in z2p[z]]

def avg(ts, prefix):
    vals=[v for t,v in data[ts].items() if t.startswith(prefix)]
    if not vals: return None
    return sum(vals)/len(vals)

print("Zone | 2017H2 mean | 2018+mean | delta")
res={}
for z in sorted(zones):
    t=z2p[z]['Zone_Air_Temperature_Sensor']
    before=[v for ts,v in data[t].items() if ts < '2018-07-01']
    after=[v for ts,v in data[t].items() if ts >= '2018-07-01']
    b=sum(before)/len(before) if before else None
    a=sum(after)/len(after) if after else None
    res[z]=(b,a,(a-b) if (b is not None and a is not None) else None)
    print(z, round(b,2) if b else b, round(a,2) if a else a, round(a-b,3) if (b and a) else None)

content.text: The F3_Z01 zone temperature is pinned exactly at the cooling setpoint (25.1–25.3 °C) every month from June onward, while its neighbors track naturally with variation. A genuinely heated zone wouldn't match the setpoint perfectly month-over-month; this exact pinning to the setpoint is the signature of a faulty/clamped temperature sensor.
